name: es20-primitive-topology
title: Primitive topology
summary: All seven glDrawArrays primitive types on shared vertex data: how vertices form points, lines and triangles, gl_PointSize / gl_PointCoord, line width and the first/count arguments, validated against a CPU reference derived from the specification.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.4 Points (3.4.1 Basic Point Rasterization, equations 3.1 and 3.2)
ES 3.0 §3.5 Line Segments (3.5.1 Basic Line Segment Rasterization, 3.5.2.1 Wide Lines)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.8.1 Input Layout Qualifiers, §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers, §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_PointSize), §7.2 Fragment Shader Special Variables (gl_PointCoord)

api.glDrawArrays: all seven modes (POINTS, LINES, LINE_STRIP, LINE_LOOP, TRIANGLES, TRIANGLE_STRIP, TRIANGLE_FAN) match the CPU topology reference; first != 0 selects the vertex range; count 0 draws nothing without error; odd or too few vertices are ignored; negative count -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glLineWidth: widths 3, 2.6, 1.4 and 0.4 produce 3, 3, 1 and 1 pixel rows (rounding, 0 acts as 1); width <= 0 -> INVALID_VALUE and GL_LINE_WIDTH unchanged; GL_LINE_WIDTH round trip and initial 1.0
api.glGetFloatv: GL_ALIASED_POINT_SIZE_RANGE and GL_ALIASED_LINE_WIDTH_RANGE contain 1 and drive which sizes and widths are drawn; GL_LINE_WIDTH
api.glGenBuffers: buffer holding the vertices of all 16 cells
api.glBindBuffer: ARRAY_BUFFER binding captured by the attribute pointers
api.glBufferData: vertex data observed through the rendered primitives
api.glBindVertexArray: VAO bound for drawing; the draw with count 0 / negative count runs on it
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: position and point-size attributes sourced from the buffer
api.glVertexAttribPointer: interleaved x,y,size layout (stride 12): point positions and per-vertex sizes appear exactly in the pixels
api.glUseProgram: solid-color and gl_PointCoord programs selected per draw
api.glUniform4f: per-draw color observed in the pixels
api.glClearColor: cell background pixels equal the clear color (every unlit pixel is compared)
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT under a scissor box per cell
api.glViewport: one 64x64 viewport per cell maps NDC to the cell's pixels
api.glScissor: one box per cell: each cell's clear touches only that cell
api.glEnable: SCISSOR_TEST: without it each per-cell clear would wipe the whole window and only the last cell would survive
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the whole default framebuffer; every check is a comparison with it

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture (es-max) viewed: 4x4 gallery. Row 1: seven dots and squares of growing size; a point-sprite gradient (black top-left, red top-right, green bottom-left, yellow bottom-right); three separate cyan bars (LINES); a green open staircase path (LINE_STRIP). Row 2: the same path closed in orange (LINE_LOOP); two separate red triangles (TRIANGLES); a green ribbon (TRIANGLE_STRIP); a blue three-quarter fan with an open wedge. Row 3: a pink vertical bar and four cyan rows of width 3, 3, 1, 1; one large orange square; three yellow sloped lines; a lime L-shaped path and a short pink segment from first/count. Row 4: lone cyan, red and orange control pieces of the too-few-vertices cell; violet disc; lime octagon with clean 45-degree edges; a house with red roof, door, window, chimneys, sun. llvmpipe captures differ from it by at most 1 per channel.
